symptom: my BME280 reads temperature fine but pressure shows ~1013 when it should be ~101300 Pa. The raw register read is correct.

gold.diagnosis: BME280 pressure registers return value in Pa but the Bosch driver compensation can emit hPa (Pa/100) depending on config. The code returns raw without the /100 or the compensation. Check the unit: 1013 hPa == 101300 Pa.
